A vertical drama, also called a vertical screen short drama or micro-drama, doesn’t have one standard episode count because it depends on the production. Most vertical dramas end up with 60 to 120 episodes, some shorter ones have around 30 to 50 episodes. Episodes are usually very brief at about 1 to 3 minutes each, which is why the overall count tends to be high. Which cameras do you use for vertical production and how many cameras are involved? We primarily shoot vertical content with the ARRI Alexa Mini LF using full-frame and vintage lens options.
Depending on the production, we typically use 1 to 3 cameras to deliver dynamic cinematic angles. We also integrate Sony FX6, Sony FX9 and DJI Ronin 4D 8K for more agile setups when needed. A micro drama is a vertical, mobile-native serialised story told in 60 to 100 episodes of one to two minutes each. Every episode ends on a hook. The format monetises through per-episode unlocks and ad breaks, which is why retention per episode matters more than production polish. Traditionally a season means months of shooting on a punishing schedule.  About the short drama production service 
 Demand for short, memorable videos is rapidly increasing, especially on social media and streaming platforms. We provide one-stop service from planning and composition to scriptwriting, filming, editing, and casting. We can also handle live-action adaptations of manga and novels.

 Digital Craftsman s short drama production service 
 
 
 
 Planning and scriptwriting 
 We will design a script to suit your needs and objectives. We can adapt existing manga, novels, and other original works into dramas, or we can create original short dramas from scratch. 
 
 
 Filming and direction 
 The story depicted in the script is expressed with the emotion and realism that only video can provide. Our video staff, led by the director, handles everything from casting and location arrangements to filming, direction, lighting, and sound, achieving both quality and speed. 
 
 
 Editing and delivery 
 Based on the footage you have shot, we will optimize the composition, tempo, sound, and color to create a finished work. We adjust every detail, including editing, subtitles, background music/sound effects, color grading, etc. We deliver in the optimal format for your purpose.
